Sensitivity Contrast Across Alternative Model Fits

Source: R/profile_sensitivity.R
profile_sensitivity.Rd

Compares profile_estimate output across two or more already-completed fits of the SAME design (same panel, same covariates, same Y/ids) made under different modelling assumptions – different interaction-prior scales (eta_sd via profile_build_design()'s interaction_sd), different max_order, different missingness handling, etc.

Usage

profile_sensitivity(
  fit_results,
  design,
  Y,
  ids,
  reference = NULL,
  estimand = "observed_preserving_conditional",
  level = c("marginal", "complete_profile"),
  n_draws = 500L,
  seed = 123L
)

Arguments

fit_results

Named list, length >= 2, each element a profile_fit_joint_bernoulli return value (or raw CmdStanMCMC) fitted against the SAME design/Y/ ids under a different assumption. Names become this comparison's columns (e.g. list(default_priors = fit1, independence_priors = fit2)).

design, Y, ids

Same as profile_estimate – the SAME values for every fit (only the posterior draws differ between fits; B/V/X are structural and do not depend on the prior that was used when fitting).

reference

Character or NULL. Name of the fit_results entry everything else is contrasted against. Default NULL: the first name in fit_results.

estimand

Passed to profile_estimate for every fit. Default "observed_preserving_conditional".

level

Character, "marginal" or "complete_profile". "marginal" collapses profile_estimate()'s per-state probabilities to per-class resistance probability first (easier to read across many classes); "complete_profile" contrasts the full per-state probabilities directly.

n_draws, seed

Passed to profile_estimate for every fit.

Value

A data frame, one row per group x class (level = "marginal") or group x state (level = "complete_profile"): each fit's value (one column per name in fit_results), one <name>_minus_<reference> SIGNED difference column per non-reference fit (direction matters – a model that moves every group's estimate up under the alternative assumption is a different finding from one that moves some up and some down by the same average magnitude, which sensitivity_contrast alone cannot distinguish), and sensitivity_contrast – the maximum ABSOLUTE difference from the reference across the other fits. This single number answers "how much does this group's estimate move" but not "in which direction" – use the signed columns for that.

Details

This function does NOT run any fits itself, by design, matching this package's standing rule that it never silently chooses a model for the caller: the caller fits each alternative explicitly (one profile_fit_joint_bernoulli call per candidate assumption, each its own tracked run with its own sampler diagnostics to check via profile_check_sampler before trusting it in this comparison) and passes the resulting fit_results in.
